generalComment.value: This EPD is based on the life cycle assessment of SAS 835/1035 from Stahlwerk Annahütte Max Aicher GmbH & Co. KG. The SAS 835/1035 is manufactured at the production site from the intermediate product steel billet in the rolling mill in 83404 Hammerau. EPD type: from cradle to factory gate with options, modules C1 to C4 and module D. The declaration holder is liable for the underlying information and evidence. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts is not liable for manufacturer information, life cycle assessment data and evidence.

description.value: It is not possible to provide a more precise breakdown of the manufacturer's specifications for the heat treatment of different steel grades and for the manufacturer's specifications for the different diameter ranges, so that an average product was considered in this LCA. The assigned waste scenarios are based on the "Nationale Milieudatabase" (NMD), the national environmental database of the Netherlands. The waste scenario is based on the predefined scenario NMD ID 74 of the "Nationale Milieudatabase". The main descriptions of the scenario can be found in Table 2 to Table 4. The environmental impacts outside the system (Module D) relate to the recycling of the product under consideration and were determined on the basis of the document "Life cycle inventory methodology report for steel products" of the World Steel Association (2017).

timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: All product and process-specific data was collected for the 2020 operating year and is therefore up to date.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The product to be declared is the average product SAS 835/1035 in the diameter range of 57 mm, 65 mm and 75 mm. The product to be declared is manufactured in the rolling mill of Stahlwerk Annahütte Max Aicher GmbH & Co. KG in 83404 Hammerau. Hot-rolled SAS 835/1035 with continuous screwable coarse thread in the diameter range 57 mm, 65 mm and 75 mm. Certain grades are heat-treated from the rolling heat. The product SAS 835/1035 is customised and supplied in different lengths according to customer requirements.

technologicalApplicability.value: Die SAS Gewindestahlprodukte finden Anwendung in der Bauindustrie, wie z.B. im Bereich der Spann- und der Geotechnik.
SAS thread bar products are used in the construction industry, e.g. in the fields of post tensioning systems and geotechnical systems.

useAdviceForDataSet.value: SAS thread bar products are used in the construction industry, e.g. in the fields of post tensioning systems and geotechnical systems.

reviewDetails.value: An independent verification of the EPD by an independent third party in accordance with ISO 14025:2010 has been performed.
